# ==========================================================
#  v3 PHASE 1 - the pre-war systems (generated by tools/build_systems.py)
#  Country variables (NSR): NSR_fitna, NSR_army_loyalty, NSR_muhajirun, NSR_bayt_al_mal,
#     NSR_inst_hijras/qadis/bayt_al_mal/mutawwa/militia (0-3), NSR_court_timer (weeks)
#  State variables: NSR_hold (0-100), NSR_hijra_count (0-2), NSR_hijra_mp
# ==========================================================

NSR_clamp_turmoil = {
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_fitna min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_army_loyalty min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_muhajirun min = 0 max = 99 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_bayt_al_mal min = 0 max = 999 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_inst_hijras min = 0 max = 3 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_inst_qadis min = 0 max = 3 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_inst_bayt_al_mal min = 0 max = 3 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_inst_mutawwa min = 0 max = 3 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_inst_militia min = 0 max = 3 }
}

# STATE scope. Set the temp variable NSR_hold_delta first.
NSR_state_hold_change = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NSR_hold_delta > 0 }
			owner = { is_power_balance_in_range = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop range = NSR_bop_court_dominant } }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { NSR_hold_delta = 0.5 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { NSR_hold = NSR_hold_delta }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_hold min = 0 max = 100 }
	NSR_refresh_presence = yes
}

# STATE scope. Shows the right presence tier.
NSR_refresh_presence = {
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NSR_ikhwan_presence_1 }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NSR_ikhwan_presence_2 }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NSR_ikhwan_presence_3 }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NSR_ikhwan_presence_4 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NSR_hold > 74 } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NSR_ikhwan_presence_4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NSR_hold > 49 } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NSR_ikhwan_presence_3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NSR_hold > 24 } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NSR_ikhwan_presence_2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NSR_hold > 0 } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NSR_ikhwan_presence_1 }
	}
}

# STATE scope. Refresh the Hijra Settlement modifier.
NSR_refresh_hijra_settlement = {
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_hijra_count min = 0 max = 2 }
	set_variable = { NSR_hijra_mp = NSR_hijra_count }
	multiply_variable = { NSR_hijra_mp = 0.05 }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NSR_hijra_settlement }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NSR_hijra_count > 0 } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NSR_hijra_settlement }
	}
}

# COUNTRY scope. Recalculate "The State Within the State" and its side effects.
NSR_refresh_sws = {
	NSR_clamp_turmoil = yes
	set_variable = { NSR_sws_pop = NSR_inst_hijras }
	multiply_variable = { NSR_sws_pop = 0.03 }
	set_variable = { NSR_sws_stab = NSR_inst_qadis }
	add_to_variable = { NSR_sws_stab = NSR_inst_mutawwa }
	multiply_variable = { NSR_sws_stab = -0.01 }
	set_variable = { NSR_sws_drift = NSR_inst_mutawwa }
	multiply_variable = { NSR_sws_drift = 0.01 }
	set_temp_variable = { NSR_t = NSR_inst_qadis }
	multiply_temp_variable = { NSR_t = 0.005 }
	add_to_variable = { NSR_sws_drift = NSR_t }
	set_variable = { NSR_sws_train = NSR_inst_militia }
	multiply_variable = { NSR_sws_train = -0.03 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NSR_fitna_started } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NSR_state_within_state_dm }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NSR_state_within_state_dm }
	}
	# institutions push the bar
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_power_balance = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop }
			check_variable = { NSR_inst_mutawwa > 0 }
			NOT = { has_power_balance_modifier = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop modifier = NSR_bop_mutawwa_preaching } }
		}
		add_power_balance_modifier = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop modifier = NSR_bop_mutawwa_preaching }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_power_balance = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop }
			check_variable = { NSR_inst_qadis > 0 }
			NOT = { has_power_balance_modifier = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop modifier = NSR_bop_qadi_courts } }
		}
		add_power_balance_modifier = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop modifier = NSR_bop_qadi_courts }
	}
	# a divided army while loyalty is 30-59
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NSR_army_loyalty > 29 }
			check_variable = { NSR_army_loyalty < 60 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NSR_fitna_started }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_idea = NSR_divided_army } }
			add_ideas = NSR_divided_army
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NSR_divided_army }
		remove_ideas = NSR_divided_army
	}
	# mirrors for the bar's description
	if = {
		limit = { owns_state = 173 }
		173 = { PREV = { set_variable = { NSR_hold_granada = PREV.NSR_hold } } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { NSR_hold_granada = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { owns_state = 169 }
		169 = { PREV = { set_variable = { NSR_hold_sevilla = PREV.NSR_hold } } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { NSR_hold_sevilla = 0 } }
}

# COUNTRY scope. Game start: variables that history files cannot set on states.
NSR_init_turmoil = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NSR_turmoil_initialised } }
		set_country_flag = NSR_turmoil_initialised
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NSR_late_start }
			if = { limit = { owns_state = 173 } 173 = { set_variable = { NSR_hold = 55 } } }
			if = { limit = { owns_state = 169 } 169 = { set_variable = { NSR_hold = 30 } } }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { owns_state = 173 } 173 = { set_variable = { NSR_hold = 35 } } }
			if = { limit = { owns_state = 169 } 169 = { set_variable = { NSR_hold = 15 } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owns_state = 173 }
			173 = {
				set_variable = { NSR_hijra_count = 1 }
				NSR_refresh_hijra_settlement = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = NSR_late_start }
			NSR_setup_late_start = yes
		}
		every_owned_state = { NSR_refresh_presence = yes }
		NSR_refresh_sws = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY scope. The 1939 start: the crisis is far along. Focus events are suppressed
# by NSR_history_setup. Values are then set to the spec (works whether or not rewards run).
NSR_setup_late_start = {
	set_country_flag = NSR_history_setup
	complete_national_focus = NSR_p_exiles_of_sabilla
	complete_national_focus = NSR_p_new_artawiya
	complete_national_focus = NSR_p_mutawwa_go_out
	complete_national_focus = NSR_p_call_to_hijrah
	complete_national_focus = NSR_p_courts_of_the_qadis
	complete_national_focus = NSR_p_bayt_al_mal
	complete_national_focus = NSR_p_ikhwan_instructors
	complete_national_focus = NSR_p_white_turbans
	complete_national_focus = NSR_p_arm_the_hijras
	complete_national_focus = NSR_p_oath_of_artawiya
	complete_national_focus = NSR_p_refuse_the_king
	clr_country_flag = NSR_history_setup
	# the flags and minimum values those focuses give
	set_country_flag = NSR_p_exiles_of_sabilla
	set_country_flag = NSR_p_new_artawiya
	set_country_flag = NSR_p_mutawwa_go_out
	set_country_flag = NSR_p_call_to_hijrah
	set_country_flag = NSR_p_courts_of_the_qadis
	set_country_flag = NSR_p_bayt_al_mal
	set_country_flag = NSR_p_ikhwan_instructors
	set_country_flag = NSR_p_white_turbans
	set_country_flag = NSR_p_arm_the_hijras
	set_country_flag = NSR_p_oath_of_artawiya
	set_country_flag = NSR_p_refuse_the_king
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_inst_hijras min = 2 max = 3 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_inst_mutawwa min = 1 max = 3 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_inst_qadis min = 1 max = 3 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_inst_bayt_al_mal min = 1 max = 3 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_inst_militia min = 1 max = 3 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_army_loyalty min = 40 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_muhajirun min = 6 max = 99 }
	clamp_variable = { var = NSR_bayt_al_mal min = 50 max = 999 }
	set_variable = { NSR_fitna = 65 }
	if = { limit = { owns_state = 173 } 173 = { set_variable = { NSR_hold = 55 } } }
	if = { limit = { owns_state = 169 } 169 = { set_variable = { NSR_hold = 30 } } }
	set_power_balance = {
		id = NSR_dual_power_bop
		left_side = NSR_bop_court_side
		right_side = NSR_bop_ikhwan_side
		set_value = 0.25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_power_balance_modifier = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop modifier = NSR_bop_court_vigilance } } }
		add_power_balance_modifier = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop modifier = NSR_bop_court_vigilance }
	}
}

# COUNTRY scope. Runs every week while the pre-war crisis lasts.
NSR_weekly_turmoil = {
	# the treasury of the Brethren fills with zakat
	set_temp_variable = { NSR_t = NSR_inst_bayt_al_mal }
	multiply_temp_variable = { NSR_t = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { NSR_bayt_al_mal = NSR_t }
	# the clock ticks faster when the Brethren are strong
	if = {
		limit = { is_power_balance_in_range = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop range = NSR_bop_ikhwan_dominant } }
		add_to_variable = { NSR_fitna = 0.5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_power_balance_in_range = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop range = NSR_bop_ikhwan_rising } }
		add_to_variable = { NSR_fitna = 0.25 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_power_balance_in_range = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop range = NSR_bop_court_dominant } }
		add_to_variable = { NSR_fitna = -0.25 }
	}
	NSR_refresh_sws = yes

	# --- the clock strikes: Fitna 100 -> the Sultan strikes first
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { NSR_fitna > 99 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NSR_war_event_pending }
		}
		set_country_flag = NSR_war_event_pending
		country_event = { id = nsr.250 days = 1 }
	}
	# --- the hard deadline -> the Vizier's ultimatum
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NSR_war_event_pending }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = NSR_late_start }
					date > 1938.12.31
				}
				date > 1939.8.31
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = NSR_war_event_pending
		country_event = { id = nsr.251 days = 1 }
	}
	# --- the court's next countermove
	else = {
		subtract_from_variable = { NSR_court_timer = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NSR_court_timer < 1 } }
			NSR_court_countermove = yes
			set_variable = { NSR_court_timer = random }
			multiply_variable = { NSR_court_timer = 8 }
			add_to_variable = { NSR_court_timer = 9 }
		}
		# the life of the hijras: a flavour event every 5-9 weeks
		subtract_from_variable = { NSR_flavor_timer = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NSR_flavor_timer < 1 } }
			NSR_prewar_flavor = yes
			set_variable = { NSR_flavor_timer = random }
			multiply_variable = { NSR_flavor_timer = 4 }
			add_to_variable = { NSR_flavor_timer = 5 }
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY scope. The AI court makes a move (weighted by the bar, Fitna and the institutions).
NSR_court_countermove = {
	random_list = {
		10 = {	# The Registration Decree
			modifier = { factor = 2 power_balance_value = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop value > 0.2 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = NSR_decree_active }
			modifier = { factor = 0 capital_scope = { check_variable = { NSR_hold > 69 } } }
			country_event = nsr.211
		}
		10 = {	# The Sultan's Stipends
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_power_balance_modifier = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop modifier = NSR_bop_court_stipends } }
			country_event = nsr.212
		}
		8 = {	# The British Consul's Inquiry
			modifier = { factor = 2 check_variable = { NSR_fitna > 30 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { NSR_fitna > 44 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = NSR_inquiry_active }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = NSR_inquiry_done }
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { country_exists = ENG } }
			country_event = nsr.213
		}
		10 = {	# Arrest of a Preacher
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 check_variable = { NSR_inst_mutawwa < 1 } }
			country_event = nsr.214
		}
		8 = {	# Transfer of the Officers
			modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { NSR_army_loyalty < 10 } }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 check_variable = { NSR_army_loyalty > 39 } }
			country_event = nsr.215
		}
		8 = {	# The Maliki Qadis' Fatwa
			modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { NSR_inst_qadis < 1 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = NSR_maliki_fatwa_done }
			country_event = nsr.202
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY scope. Welcome the Muhajirun: +5 Hold in the owned state with the lowest Hold.
NSR_hold_to_lowest_state = {
	set_temp_variable = { NSR_min_hold = 101 }
	every_owned_state = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { NSR_hold < NSR_min_hold } }
			set_temp_variable = { NSR_min_hold = NSR_hold }
		}
	}
	random_owned_state = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { NSR_hold > NSR_min_hold } } }
		set_temp_variable = { NSR_hold_delta = 5 }
		NSR_state_hold_change = yes
	}
}

# COUNTRY scope. A hijrah campaign starts / ends (the wave pushes the bar while any campaign runs).
NSR_hijrah_campaign_start = {
	add_to_variable = { NSR_active_campaigns = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_power_balance_modifier = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop modifier = NSR_bop_hijrah_wave } } }
		add_power_balance_modifier = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop modifier = NSR_bop_hijrah_wave }
	}
}
NSR_hijrah_campaign_end = {
	subtract_from_variable = { NSR_active_campaigns = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NSR_active_campaigns < 1 } }
		set_variable = { NSR_active_campaigns = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_power_balance = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop } }
			remove_power_balance_modifier = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop modifier = NSR_bop_hijrah_wave }
		}
	}
	country_event = { id = nsr.260 days = 1 }
}

# ==========================================================
#  THE SPLIT (phase 1; phase 3 hooks: NSR_after_split / NSR_after_bloodless in NSR_civil_war_effects.txt)
#  Called by nsr.250 (the Sultan strikes first), nsr.251 (the ultimatum) and, from phase 2,
#  by the focus "The Night of the White Turbans".
#  The player's country (NSR) is always the Ikhwan side; the loyalists are the breakaway.
# ==========================================================
NSR_start_andalusi_civil_war = {
	set_country_flag = NSR_fitna_started
	clr_country_flag = NSR_war_event_pending
	# 1. remember the pre-war results, then remove the bar (BoP values are global)
	set_variable = { NSR_final_bop = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { power_balance_value = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop value > 0.59 } }
		set_variable = { NSR_final_bop = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { power_balance_value = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop value > 0.19 } }
		set_variable = { NSR_final_bop = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_power_balance = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop } }
		remove_power_balance = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop }
	}
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = NSR_state_within_state_dm }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NSR_divided_army }
		remove_ideas = NSR_divided_army
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NSR_shura_of_the_sheikhs }
		remove_ideas = NSR_shura_of_the_sheikhs
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = NSR_parallel_emirate }
		remove_ideas = NSR_parallel_emirate
	}
	# 2. size from the bar: Ikhwan dominant 0.20, rising 0.30, otherwise 0.45; +0.10 if the Sultan struck first
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NSR_final_bop = 2 } }
		set_variable = { NSR_cw_size = 0.20 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NSR_final_bop = 1 } }
		set_variable = { NSR_cw_size = 0.30 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { NSR_cw_size = 0.45 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NSR_struck_first }
		add_to_variable = { NSR_cw_size = 0.10 }
	}
	# 3. army ratio (share of the regular army that goes to the loyalists) from army loyalty
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NSR_army_loyalty > 59 } }
		set_variable = { NSR_cw_army = 0.25 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { NSR_army_loyalty > 29 } }
		set_variable = { NSR_cw_army = 0.40 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { NSR_cw_army = 0.55 } }
	# 4. navy and air force are royalist unless won over
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = NSR_navy_won
			NOT = { has_country_flag = NSR_struck_first }
		}
		set_variable = { NSR_cw_navy = 0.5 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { NSR_cw_navy = 0.8 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = NSR_air_won }
		set_variable = { NSR_cw_air = 0.4 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { NSR_cw_air = 0.7 } }
	# 5. which states? Hold below 50 and no won-over garrison. Fallback: Sevilla.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { any_owned_state = { NSR_state_goes_loyalist = yes } }
			owns_state = 169
			NOT = { capital_scope = { state = 169 } }
		}
		169 = { set_state_flag = NSR_loyalist_forced }
	}
	set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no }
	if = {
		limit = { any_owned_state = { NSR_state_goes_loyalist = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { 169 = { is_owned_by = ROOT NSR_state_goes_loyalist = yes } }
			meta_effect = {
				text = {
					start_civil_war = {
						ideology = neutrality
						size = [SIZE]
						army_ratio = [ARMY]
						navy_ratio = [NAVY]
						air_ratio = [AIR]
						capital = 169
						states = all
						states_filter = { NSR_state_goes_loyalist = yes }
						keep_all_characters = yes
						NSR_cw_loyalist_setup = yes
					}
				}
				SIZE = "[?NSR_cw_size|.2]"
				ARMY = "[?NSR_cw_army|.2]"
				NAVY = "[?NSR_cw_navy|.2]"
				AIR = "[?NSR_cw_air|.2]"
			}
		}
		else = {
			meta_effect = {
				text = {
					start_civil_war = {
						ideology = neutrality
						size = [SIZE]
						army_ratio = [ARMY]
						navy_ratio = [NAVY]
						air_ratio = [AIR]
						states = all
						states_filter = { NSR_state_goes_loyalist = yes }
						keep_all_characters = yes
						NSR_cw_loyalist_setup = yes
					}
				}
				SIZE = "[?NSR_cw_size|.2]"
				ARMY = "[?NSR_cw_army|.2]"
				NAVY = "[?NSR_cw_navy|.2]"
				AIR = "[?NSR_cw_air|.2]"
			}
		}
		NSR_after_split = yes	# phase 3: takeover, Ikhwani tree, Shura BoP, nsr.300, nsr_news.10
	}
	else = {
		# NSR owns only its capital: a bloodless takeover, the Sultan flees to Gibraltar
		set_country_flag = NSR_bloodless_takeover
		NSR_after_bloodless = yes	# phase 3: takeover, Ikhwani tree, Shura BoP, nsr.305, nsr_news.1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { owns_state = 169 }
		169 = { clr_state_flag = NSR_loyalist_forced }
	}
}

# BREAKAWAY scope (inside start_civil_war): THIS = the loyalists, PREV = the Ikhwani NSR
NSR_cw_loyalist_setup = {
	NSR_cw_court_figures_to_breakaway = yes
	NSR_cw_ikhwan_units_stay_home = yes
	save_global_event_target_as = NSR_loyalists
	set_country_flag = NSR_loyalist_side
	add_ideas = NSR_the_sultans_cause
	load_focus_tree = { tree = NSR_loyalist_tree keep_completed = no }
}
